Finding things to do in this neighbourhood is very easy. There is a wide variety of entertainment venues, there are often a very large number of people around, and with its a few bars, it is very easy to find a place to grab a drink since they are generally located very close by. Rue Jean-Talon in particular offers a broad selection of nightlife. Greenery is not very present in this part of Montréal; although, it is very easy to access parks in the neighbourhood since there are a few of them nearby for residents to enjoy.
